agents.pk_quote: The concentration of E5 peaked in the blood 2 h after subcutaneous administration and gradually decreased within 24 h. On the basis of the curve, E5 demonstrated good stability in vivo, and the mouse half-life was ~10 h. Tmax is taken from the phrase 'peaked in the blood 2 h after subcutaneous administration'; no numeric Cmax is given because the readout is fluorescence intensity in arbitrary units. The paper names no kinetic phase, so half_life_phase is unspecified.
agents.pk_section: RESULTS - E5 had good in vivo stability through hepatic metabolic clearance

concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: Pharmacokinetic profile of E5 subcutaneously administered to mice at different time points (n=3)... (a) The fluorescence intensity in the serum samples after FITC-E5 injection.
concentration_time_figure.note: Fluorescence intensity versus time in serum after a single s.c. dose of FITC-E5; the signal is fluorescence intensity rather than an absolute mass concentration. Figure 7c is the corresponding liver and kidney fluorescence intensity curve.

bioanalytical_method: Fluorescence detection of FITC-labelled peptide in serum using a Synergy H1 Hybrid Multi-Mode microplate reader (excitation 488 nm, emission 525 nm); organ fluorescence imaging with a Xenogen IVIS Spectrum system
bioanalytical_quote: the fluorescence of the serum samples was measured using the Synergy H1 Hybrid Multi-Mode microplate reader... at an excitation wavelength of 488 nm and an emission wavelength of 525 nm
bioanalytical_section: METHODS - In vivo pharmacokinetics of E5
notes: PK was performed with the FITC-conjugated peptide in healthy female BALB/c mice, not with unlabelled E5 and not in tumour-bearing animals. The half-life is reported as an approximate value ('~10 h') read off the curve; no fitting method, model or phase is described, so half_life_phase is 'unspecified' and no absorption/elimination split is claimed. Tmax (2 h) comes from the body statement that concentration 'peaked in the blood 2 h after subcutaneous administration'; no numeric Cmax or AUC is given because the readout is fluorescence intensity. Comparator half-lives quoted in the DISCUSSION (BKT140 and CTCE-9908 <1 h, LY2510924 3-5 h) are cited literature for other compounds and are not recorded as measurements from this study. CXCL12 and MS-5 conditioned medium were applied in vitro as chemotactic stimuli rather than as test agents, and are therefore not listed as agents. The PEPLIFE2 header names the PK agent 'FITC-conjugated E5' with half-life ~10 h, consistent with the body.
